tools.name: create_report
tools.description:
Create a Maps Census report: counts of Google Maps places for business types in a zone, with optional filters, rows split by one dimension and a measure in columns. Returns the report URL at once; call get_report for the figures.
Each row costs one count, plus one per column (two for a share).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get a Maps Census report. Once ready: its title, criteria, table (a header line, then one line per group; raw counts, with the legend's marks for hidden figures) and key points, plus the PDF URL for a full report. Until then: the status and when to retry. The status is counting, then for a full repo

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "census" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_report · Public sink: create_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_report · Public sink: create_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
